This directly exploits Garvit's massive comment-to-like ratio (1828.1 comments to 435 likes) to trigger the Instagram algorithm's viral loop.

Action 3: Optimize Posting Schedule to the Peak Evening Window
Data indicates Garvit's optimal posting window is between 6:00 PM and 9:00 PM IST. Schedule all Reels strictly during this 3-hour window.
